verdict.rationale: Reflect's API docs link to a full OpenAPI 3.0.0 spec published on openpm (openpm.ai/packages/reflect/openapi.json). It covers the graphs, links, daily-notes, notes and users/me endpoints with OAuth2 scopes, so a machine-readable spec is downloadable. The probe 404s only show that the spec is not hosted at standard paths on reflect.academy; they do not contradict the openpm-hosted spec. Missing for 10: a spec hosted on the vendor's own domain or a well-known path, any versioning or deprecation policy (the spec sits at version 0.1.0), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the spec is current and complete.
